title: N--Installation and Maintenance of a Casualty Control (CASCON) evacuation and alarm reporting system onboard a forward deployed vessel in Yokosuka, Japan.
description: Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound will be soliciting for the installation, maintenance and removal of a Casualty Control (CASCON) evacuation and alarm reporting system onboard a forward deployed vessel in support of the U.S. Naval SRF-JRMC Yokosuka, Japan. The Government will provide the system itself and requires only installation, maintenance and removal of the system. This acquisition will be negotiated on a full and open competitive basis. Interested persons may identify their interest and capability to respond to the requirement or submit proposals prior to offer due date. It is anticipated that the solicitation will be posted to the NECO website on or about 24 March 2016 with proposals due by 04 April 2016. title: M--Operation of Government owned facilities, Guam Base Operations Support Contract
description: This solicitation is for Base Operations Support (BOS) Services for Joint Region Marianas (JRM), Guam. Guam, the largest and southernmost island of the Marianas archipelago, is the westernmost possession of the United States. JRM Guam plays a key role in providing logistic and mission support to the operating forces for all U.S. military forces deployed in the Western Pacific. BOS Services are essential to military operations and facility maintenance on Guam and must be adaptable to JRM’s ever-changing operational environment. Sources sought notice N6274219R1199 for this procurement was posted on 15 October 2018 on NECO and FBO, and a market survey was conducted that included an assessment of relevant qualifications and capabilities of potentially qualified firms. As a result of the market research analysis, a determination was made to solicit this procurement on an UNRESTRICTED basis inviting full and open competition. The NAVFAC Pacific small business office concurs with this decision. The solicitation will be advertised on an unrestricted basis inviting full and open competition. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code for this procurement is 561210 and the annual size standard is $38,500,000. The Government intends to award a Cost-Plus-Award-Fee contract. The anticipated procurement is for these operations services: General Information, Management and Administration, Port Operations, Ordnance, Facility Management, Facility Investment, Utility Management, Electrical, Wastewater, Steam, Water, and Base Support Vehicles and Equipment The contract period of performance is anticipated to consist of a twelve-month base period (to include a three-month mobilization/phase-in period), six (6) 12-month option periods, and one (1) 12-month option period (to include a four-month demobilization/phase-out period). The Government will not issue a synopsis when exercising the option(s). The Government may require the Contractor to continue performance for an additional period of up to six (6) months under FAR 52.217-8, Option to Extend Services, clause. Offerors can view and/or download the solicitation, and any attachments, at Federal Business Opportunities, www.fbo.gov or at Navy Electronic Commerce Online, www.neco.navy.mil when it becomes available. All proposals from responsible sources electing to submit a proposal in response to the solicitation will be considered. The solicitation utilizes a source selection process that requires offerors to submit a Cost and a Technical proposal for evaluation by the Government. Contract award will be made to the responsible offeror whose proposal, conforming to the solicitation, represents the best value to the Government, Cost and Technical factors considered. The anticipated technical evaluation factors are as follows: (A) Past Performance; (B) Corporate Experience; (C) Management; (D) Technical Approach; (E) Safety; and (F) Small Business Utilization PRE-PROPOSAL CONFERENCE: A pre-proposal conference will be held on Tuesday, 23 July 2019 on Guam. The exact location of the pre-proposal conference on Guam will be determined at a later date. The purpose of the conference will be to familiarize prospective offerors with the extent and nature of the project. The Government reserves the right to limit the number of attendees per company. Registration for the conference will begin at 8:00 a.m. and the conference will commence at 9:00 a.m. Please check the websites at www.neco.navy.mil and www.fbo.gov for any updates to the conference. Parties interested in attending the pre-proposal conference shall submit the following information to NFPACQ2@navy.mil no later than Friday, 5 July 2019 at 2:00 p.m. HST: company name, business size, point of contact, name of individuals with title, phone numbers, fax numbers, e-mail addresses. SITE VISIT: A site visit will be held following the pre-proposal conference Tuesday, 23 – 31 July 2019 on Guam. The Government reserves the right to limit the number of attendees per company for the site visit. Transportation for the site visit will be provided, but all other expenses will be the attendee’s responsibility. It is the responsibility of the offeror to arrange for meals, lodging needs and transportation to Guam. Contractors are responsible for providing their own personal protection equipment (PPE), which includes hard hats, eye protection, hearing protection, and flat covered shoes (i.e. athletic type) for the site visit. Steel toe shoes are not required for the site visit. Individuals without the proper PPE may be restricted access to certain areas. Parties interested in attending the site visit shall submit the following information to NFPACQ2@navy.mil no later than Friday, 5 July 2019 at 2:00 p.m. HST: full name, gender, proof of citizenship, name of firm representing, position/title, social security number, complete company address, and e-mail addresses. Acceptable proof of citizenship documents include a copy of: U.S. passport, U.S. birth certificate, or U.S. Certificate of Naturalization. A driver’s license is NOT an acceptable form of citizenship. Non-U.S. citizens must provide a copy of their passport. Please also include any specific area(s) attendee would like to see while on the site visit to ensure the Government may at its best accommodate. Please check the websites at www.neco.navy.mil and www.fbo.gov for any updates to the site visit. To be prepared, site visit attendees need to fill out the following forms and submit it to the below POC’s for Naval Base Guam and Andersen Air Force Base, Guam. For Naval Base Guam: 1) Complete Base Access Request (BAR) Cover Letter (Attachment JL-10). 2) Complete CNIC Base Access Pass Registration Form - OMB 0703-0061 (Attachment JL-10). 3) It is the responsibility of all interested attendees to submit their base access request forms to NBG VCC supervisor for processing and follow up. 4) Those that do not confirm their base access requests may not be able to participate. For Andersen Air Force Base, Guam: 1) Base Access List Instructions (Attachment JL-11). 2) Complete Base Access List (Attachment JL-11). 3) Complete Base Access Affidavit (Attachment JL-11). 4) It is the responsibility of all interested attendees to follow up and make sure NSAA base passes are processed and ready for pick up. 5) Those that do not confirm their base access requests may not be able to participate. Failure to submit registration information for the pre-proposal conference and site visit by Friday, 5 July 2019 at 2:00 p.m. HST will preclude your firm’s inclusion in the event(s). The solicitation will be issued on or after 5 July 2019. THE SOLICITATION WILL BE AVAILABLE IN ELECTRONIC FORMAT ONLY. The RFP will be posted on the Federal Business Opportunities (FBO) website at www.fbo.gov and on the Navy Electronic Commerce Online (NECO) website at www.neco.navy.mil. No hard copies will be provided. IT IS THE CONTRACTORS RESPONSIBILITY TO CHECK EITHER WEBSITE DAILY FOR ANY AMENDMENTS TO THIS SOLICITATION. Prospective offerors MUST register themselves on either website. Offerors are required to be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database at https://www.sam.gov/SAM. The information being requested does not constitute a commitment on the part of the government to award a contract, nor to pay for any costs incurred as a result in replying to this notice. This notice should not be construed as a commitment by the government for any purpose.

title: Westlaw on-line subscription
description: The Naval Supply (NAVSUP) Systems Command, Fleet Logistics Center Jacksonville (FLCJ), FL intends to issue a sole source award utilizing Simplified Acquisition Procedures for Commercial Items to West Publishing Corporation dba West, A Thomson Reuters Business for the procurement of Westlaw On-line subscription for Fleet Readiness Center Southeast (FRCSE). West Publishing Corporation is the sole source provider for Westlaw. West Publishing Corporation is a privately-owned company and has the sole ownership of Westlaw on-line subscription which includes the exclusive content, features, and services listed. This system allows access to the myriad of laws and statutes, rules, regulation as well as court and agency decisions, which impact the mission of the Fleet Readiness Center Southeast, Jacksonville. Intended use is as a research tool to carry out the mission in diverse practice areas, including but not limited to: civilian personnel law, labor and employment law, fiscal/acquisition law, and ethics. Westlaw software has proven compatible with existing operating systems at FRCSE. The required Westlaw software shall be delivered to FRCSE five (5) days after contract award. This procurement is for the annual subscription renewal period of 01 July 2019 through 30 June 2020 with four (4) one-year option periods. The applicable North American Industrial Classification System Code (NAICS) that this work falls under is 519130 Internet Publishing and Broadcasting and Web Search Portals, with a size standard of 1000 employees. This notice of intent is for information purposes only. It is the Government’s intent to make a sole source award to West Publishing Corporation for this acquisition. Phone calls will not be accepted. Responses must be supported with clear and convincing evidence that clearly communicate the company’s ability to satisfy this requirement as outlined above. A request for documentation will not be considered as an affirmative response. If no responses are received within four (4) calendar days after publication of this notice to demonstrate comparable capability, then a sole source acquisition award will be made. Responses shall be in writing and sent via e-mail to Contract Specialist, Maxine.lopez@navy.mil AND Contracting Officer, Javier.aponte@navy.mil.

title: Army Combat Fitness Test (ACFT) Equipment
description: Synopsis: Army Combat Fitness Test (ACFT) Equipment NAICS: 339920 NSN: 7830-01-675-1851 The United States Army Contracting Command - Warren (ACC-WRN) intends to issue a Request for Proposal (RFP), W56HZV-19-R-0028, for the effort described herein. A Sources Sought Notice (ACFT26OCT2018) was posted to FedBizOpps on 26 Oct 2018 for ACFT equipment. The Sources Sought Notice closed on 09 Nov 2018 and provided ACC-WRN with the market's capabilities of providing ACFT equipment to the United States Government (USG). The market research determined that there is capacity limitations with manufacturing components. Subcontracting opportunities are expected. The following companies participated in the market survey and chose to be identified: - Inventory Management Solutions, LLC - Beaverfit - Crane Fitness - Enterprise Furniture Consultants - Quality Specialty Products - Eleiko - American Barbell - Wright Equipment - Hi-Temp - Sorinex - ADS, Inc - Pierce Distribution Services - Life Fitness As a result, this requirement will be 100% set-aside to small business. The Government anticipates awarding a firm fixed price (FFP) Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract to include three ordering periods. The RFP is expected to be released on FedBizOpps in December 2018 and close 30 days after date of issuance. The Government is expecting to award a single, all or none contract no later than March 2019. All responsible sources may submit a bid, proposal, or quotation which shall be considered by the agency. The ACFT is a six event test comprised of 11 items of fitness equipment per lane (one set) that will measure muscular strength, muscular endurance, power, flexibility, coordination, speed, agility, cardiovascular endurance, balance, and reaction time. It is the first new physical fitness test for the Army in 38 years. The contract requirement will be for the contractor to acquire ACFT equipment and to kit sets. It is anticipated that the guaranteed minimum quantity will be estimated at 26,000 sets and the maximum quantity estimated at 30,000 sets. Deliveries of the ACFT equipment must be in-hand to Army units no later than 01 Oct 2019. Phased deliveries are recommended to start no later than April 2019 in order to meet the required in-hand date. The Government anticipates utilizing Government Bill of Lading (GBL) Transportation Authorization Code (TAC) for all direct vendor delivery of AFCT equipment to the Army units. The following is a description of each of the ACFT equipment items the contractor will acquire including the estimated total minimum/maximum quantities of each. One set will include the specified number of quantities of each item (identified below as 1 x, 2 x, 4 x, etc.). a. 1 x Hexagon Bar/Trap-Bar Non-rust bar due to outside usage & storage; d-handle hexagon barbell are not allowed. Loadable sleeve length must be able to hold x 4 45lb bumper plates with collar. Weight of bar should be standard 60lb empty. (Quantity 26,000/30,000 each) b. Bumper Plates (550lb). Bumper plates to be solid rubber plates made from 100% virgin or high quality recycled rubber with an insert type of forged stainless steel and consist of the following specifications: 4 x 10lb Plate Width 1 3/8" (Quantity 104,000/120,000 each) 2 x 15lb Plate Width 1 7/8" (Quantity 52,000/60,000 each) 2 x 25lb Plate Width 2 1/4" (Quantity 52,000/60,000 each)2 x 35lb Plate Width 3 1/8" (Quantity 52,000/60,000 each) 8 x 45lb Plate Width 3 3/4" (Quantity 208,000/240,000 each) c. 1 x (Pair) Barbell Collar/Spring. Designed to be used on 50mm Olympic bar sleeves. Made of long lasting rubber interior to protect barbell and provide a snug fit. Quick and easy locking mechanism provides secure hold and easy on/off. (Quantity 26,000/30,000 pairs) d. 1 x Nylon Sled (With Pull Strap). The nylon sled to be dragged on multiple surfaces (grass and turf). The sled to handle up to four 45lb plates. (Quantity 26,000/30,000 each) e. 1 x 10lb Rubber Medicine Ball. A medicine ball approximately 9" in diameter and must be 10lbs. No other weight is acceptable. (Quantity 26,000/30,000 each) f. 2 x 40lb Kettlebell. The kettlebell can be a cast-iron or cast steel weight (resembling a cannonball with a handle) used to perform many types of exercises, including but not limited to ballistic exercises that combine cardiovascular, strength and flexibility training. Should be made of a natural, slip-free texture with a seamless and even finish. (Quantity 52,000/60,000 each) g. 1 x Measuring Tape (Metric). Must be capable of measuring in metric. Durable, long-lasting, vinyl-coated fiberglass tapes in ABS shatter resistant case. Closed reel tapes feature an easy to wind, flush-folding handle. Tape must be made of fiberglass. Manufactured/designed for working outdoors in muddy or wet conditions. Should be durable and easily cleaned. (Quantity 26,000/30,000 each) After procuring or manufacturing all of the 11 ACFT equipment components, the contractor will package (kit) each set in a single storage crate. This storage crate will encompass one set, NSN: 7830-01-675-1851. Companies who are interested subcontracting any of this effort may choose to be identified as interested sources on FedBizOpps. Questions related to this requirement are to be submitted to the Contract Specialist at the time of the release of the solicitation only. The point of contact for this action is Lee Tappy, Contract Specialist, lee.f.tappy.civ@mail.mil
